title: Visualizations — interpreted §9 charts (who-wins, agree-vs-disagree, drift/nudge per side, tokens/latency per round) saved to notebooks/figures and embedded in the notebook (Epic 14, issue #99)
prompt:
Produce charts for the analyses and save them; interpret each in prose connecting observations to the design (§9 wants interpretation, not just numbers).

Follow repo standards: TDD (write the failing test first, then code); max 150 lines per code file (split, don't compress); ruff = 0 violations + mypy clean; no hard-coded values (read from config); every external API call goes through the API gatekeeper (Epic 13); log via the LOG package; keep coverage >= 85%. Read docs/PRD.md and the relevant docs/prds/*.md before starting.

usage.summary: Read PRD §9 + the 14.2 analysis module/notebook; TDD red-first viz test; built a guarded-matplotlib chart module reusing the analysis functions; rendered + committed 4 PNGs; interpreted each in prose; embedded charts into the notebook; full gate suite.

note: Implements the PRD §9 INTERPRETED visualizations. CHART MODULE: NEW packages/core/src/agent_debate/core/research/viz.py (~71 code lines, under the 150 cap) with pure-ish save functions that REUSE the 14.2 analysis functions (who_wins/agree_vs_disagree/nudges_per_side + RoundMetric) rather than re-aggregating: save_who_wins_chart, save_agree_disagree_chart, save_nudges_chart, save_round_tokens_chart (tokens bars + latency line on a twin axis, returns None for empty rounds), and save_all_figures wrapper. Out dir is always a caller arg (no hard-coded paths); created if missing. GUARDED IMPORT: matplotlib is imported inside a _pyplot() helper (deferred), which forces the headless Agg backend and raises a clear ImportError with install guidance if the viz extra is absent — so importing agent_debate.core NEVER fails without matplotlib; only drawing a chart needs it. DEP DECISION: matplotlib added to the dev dependency-group AND a new [dependency-groups] viz group (uv sync --group viz), NOT a runtime dep of core — the charts are a research/notebook concern, the SDK/API/CLI surfaces stay matplotlib-free. mypy [[tool.mypy.overrides]] module=matplotlib.* ignore_missing_imports=true (matplotlib ships no stubs). uv.lock updated. TDD RED-FIRST: NEW packages/core/tests/test_research_viz.py (8 tests, synthetic RunSummary/RoundMetric fixtures + tmp_path, Agg backend) watched the import fail, then GREEN — asserts each helper writes a non-empty .png, empty-rounds returns None, save_all_figures count, and the out dir is auto-created. GENERATOR: NEW scripts/generate_figures.py (thin CLI mirroring scripts/aggregate_runs.py): aggregate_runs -> pick the largest-round run for the per-round chart -> save_all_figures to notebooks/figures; --runs-dir/--out flags default to DEFAULT_RUNS_DIR and notebooks/figures (no magic paths); no external API calls (Epic-13 N/A); UTF-8 console reconfigure for Windows. RAN it against the real runs: 4 PNGs written (who_wins, agree_vs_disagree, nudges_per_side, round_tokens_capitalism) — visually verified: who-wins pro:2/tie:1/con:1; round tokens climb ~14k->51k over 10 rounds with latency tracking. PROSE: NEW notebooks/figures/README.md interprets each chart connecting to the design — balanced who-wins (no structural favourite, side-anchoring §5); 0% convergence as EXPECTED for an adversarial format (high agree rate would signal sycophancy); 0/0 nudges meaning the anti-sycophancy anchoring held WITHOUT controller intervention (nudge path itself covered by engine staged-drift tests 8.4); super-linear tokens/latency growth per round = the §10 cost signature (context replay), so ROUNDS/MAX_WORDS are the cheapest levers; honest about n=4. NOTEBOOK: added a §5 viz section to notebooks/analysis.ipynb (markdown intro + a code cell that renders via save_all_figures + an IPython.display cell + an interpretation markdown), EXECUTED end-to-end so the 4 charts render inline; then STRIPPED all text/stream outputs keeping ONLY the image/png display_data so no printed value/secret is committed. UPDATED the 14.2 smoke test packages/core/tests/test_analysis_notebook.py: was test_notebook_outputs_are_cleared (forbade ALL outputs) — now test_notebook_carries_no_text_outputs allows image/png display_data only and forbids text/stream (task explicitly permits committing rendered chart images). GATES GREEN: uv sync --group viz clean; ruff check . = All checks passed; ruff format --check . = 245 files formatted (notebook code cells reformatted by docstring-code-format); mypy = Success 242 source files; pytest --cov = 849 passed, 99.22% total (viz.py 99%) >= 85%; check_line_limit.py passed; secret_scan only flags the real local gitignored .env (documented pre-existing). PRE-EXISTING failures unchanged (6 failed + 2 errors, identical on clean main): branch-protection Unix perms x2, live-tree secret scan/hygiene x2 (real .env), Windows missing-file path-regex x2, long-topic parametrized teardown errors x2 — NO new failures (the transient test_analysis_notebook failure from embedding images was resolved by updating that smoke test). Files: NEW core/research/viz.py, core/tests/test_research_viz.py, scripts/generate_figures.py, notebooks/figures/{README.md,who_wins.png,agree_vs_disagree.png,nudges_per_side.png,round_tokens_capitalism.png}, this artifact; EDIT core/research/__init__.py (export 5 viz fns), core/tests/test_analysis_notebook.py (allow image outputs), notebooks/analysis.ipynb (§5 viz section + embedded charts), pyproject.toml (matplotlib dev+viz group, mypy override, generate_figures in mypy files), uv.lock, docs/PROMPTS.md (14.3 entry), docs/TASKS.md (14.3 [x]). Closes #99.
